summary_markdown:
The session discussed the process of integrating facility data, specifically addressing whether modeled data would replace real data. It was clarified that the modeling will not replace the real sessions initially calculated by the attached box's data (real sessions). Instead, the system first processes the real sessions from the attached box, then adds donor box sessions mapped by someone, and finally applies the model across all combined sessions.

This process is designed to be seamless and congruent, but remains virtual-to-real.
decisions: The modeling data will not replace the initial real session calculations from the attached box.
